assets.generationMode: new foreground from architectural brief with new background camera reference
assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Generate an entirely NEW photographic FOREGROUND OVERLAY for Galactica-4 laboratory. Input image 1 is a supporting camera/lighting reference showing the newly built background hangar; it is NOT an edit target and none of its background pixels, right-hand people, architecture or floor should appear in output. Construct new real foreground objects in the same SINGLE camera projection: 35mm lens, elevated 2.2m eye-height, slight 8-degree downward angle, horizon/vanishing point near x55%,y40%. Actual rigid rectangular screen enclosures and desk planes converge to this shared perspective; consistent human and equipment scale, no traced hand-drawn geometry. Foreground overlay contains exactly TWO seated adult technicians seen from rear/three-quarter back in navy industrial workwear, operating a compact stack of two rectangular blue monitors and desk controls ONLY in lower-left quadrant. Person heads around y62% of frame, upper bodies extend to y82%, seated scientists occupy x3%-22%, monitors x21%-33%, top of tallest monitor no higher than y62%; staff hands connect naturally to controls. A simple dark satin steel counter/console lip crosses the entire BOTTOM 15% of frame, correctly projected as one flat coherent rigid desk, with only sparse small accurate keys, switches and a single dim screen embedded flush in desk. Match the reference's plausible materials, cool blue ambient and restrained warm work lights, sharp natural photographic detail without excessive random texture. Output ENTIRE UPPER 60% and middle-right 85% area must be genuine EMPTY TRANSPARENT ALPHA; no floor, hangar, walls, right people, rails, opaque backdrop or black matte. All holes between foreground people, monitors and desk transparent. Do not render or copy the reference background. Standalone isolated foreground photographed in same viewpoint, not a small painted miniature. Exact 408:240 landscape, about1632x960. No text or watermark.
assets.export: Aspect-preserving resize and center crop; transparent canvas preserves alpha.

assets.name: defeat
assets.prompt: Edit the referenced existing Galactica-4 artwork into a convincingly photographic second edition. Preserve exact subject identity, structural design, silhouette, attachment counts, orientation, placement, framing, colors and composition. Cinematic photographic combat still of the same exhausted adult soldier centered in dark gray powered armor with thin gold trim, grim face visible through visor, one gloved hand across abdomen and weapon held low. Tack-sharp face, visor edges, torso mechanical joints and glove, authentic sweaty skin pores and believable soot, precise armor seams and fasteners, restrained physical wear rather than random mottled texture. Full-frame 70mm lens f/3.2 focused on soldier: progressive optical defocus on distant fleeing troops, burning white futuristic city, red/blue flag, sky spacecraft and purple beams; distinct subject separation and smoky atmospheric depth. Real practical costume/material photography with controlled fire highlight exposure and soft restrained bloom. No painterly texture, plastic CGI or excessive global sharpening. Preserve original composition and story, no gore. Same aspect 500:432, opaque image, no text.
